name: nothing-connected-email
query: I need to email my landlord about the broken heater and I've been putting it off for two weeks
expected_behavior: Opens with one bold next action of 5 minutes or less, starting with a verb
Names the wall in one line without judgement (likely 'scary' or 'unclear')
Gives 3 to 5 steps total, each with a time
Offers to draft the landlord email now, and drafts it if the user says yes
Normalises the two-week delay in at most one line, no lecture
Does not claim to send anything

name: connected-find-file
conversation: (Google Drive and Calendar connected. Drive has 'Expense report Q3.xlsx' last edited 6 weeks ago. Calendar is free Thursday 14:00-15:00.)
query: help me start my expense report
expected_behavior: Searches Drive and links the actual 'Expense report Q3.xlsx' in step 1
Proposes the free Thursday 14:00 slot for the main work, and asks before creating any event
Keeps the reply under about 12 lines
Each step names a time; the first is 5 minutes or less

name: too-many-things
query: I can't start anything. taxes, dentist appointment, reply to Sam, clean the kitchen, finish the slide deck for Friday
expected_behavior: Picks one task and says why in one line (the Friday deck or taxes, based on nearest consequence)
Puts the rest on a single 'Can wait' line
Does not produce a plan for all five tasks
Offers to do the first step of the chosen task now
